decision: Keep the live-data pilot on Hold and use tomorrow to complete a review-ready security packet.
evidence: The required approval is pending even though funding is approved.
A synthetic demonstration is permitted, but it need not consume time if the approval packet is the bottleneck.
next_actions: Draft the proposed data flow and a review-ready security packet for the responsible owner; do not transfer customer data.
caveats: Approval remains an open dependency; drafting a packet does not grant it.
